deadline.value: Applications for September 2027 entry accepted October 1 to February 1; references must also be in by the deadline.
deadline.quote: APPLICATIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED FOR SEPTEMBER ENTRY TO OUR GRADUATE PROGRAM STARTING ON OCTOBER 1 UNTIL FEBRUARY 1.

supervisor.value: Contact faculty first and apply only after a positive response; a supervisor willing to take you is an admission factor.
supervisor.quote: Find a potential supervisor willing to supervise your program (see step 2 for more details). | Only once you've received a positive response from at least one academic encouraging you to apply, should you complete the remaining steps.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are funded for the first 5 years at a minimum of about CAD 29,316 a year.
funding.quote: All students admitted to our graduate program have secured financial support for at least the first 2.3 years of an M.Sc. program and the first 5 years of a Ph.D. program

entry_route.value: Minimum is a 4-year undergraduate degree with a 3.3/4 GPA; you enter either the MSc or the PhD.
entry_route.quote: The Department’s minimum admission requirements are a 4-year undergraduate degree with an admission GPA of at least 3.3 on the 4-point scale

notes: Departmental package (CV, financial support form, research interest form) and three references required. Specializations suspended.
